name: Development graph
blurb: Issues, epics, specs, decisions, pull requests, releases and incidents as one graph, with the Git host still the record for code.
about: Build a living system of record for software development, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps issues, epics, specs, decisions, pull requests, releases and incidents linked to the components they touch and to the invariants and principles that constrain them. Whether work is ready, blocked or stale is worked out from those links on every read, so no status drifts. Agents triage, trace and report, writing on branches for a person to review.
